name: com.samicodeslikeit.atlasforge
description: Editor tool for UI sprite atlases: pack a folder of sprites into one tightly packed, sliced atlas with 9-slice borders (manual or auto-detected), repack existing atlases to reclaim empty space, merge several atlases into one, delete duplicate slices, edit 9-slice borders and slice rects with the mouse, and export slices as standalone sprites, all while keeping every sprite reference in the project intact.
